scripts.features:
ZekeHub is a paid script hub with dedicated scripts for 26 games and a universal script for 31 more. One loader detects the game you are in and loads the right script. Built and maintained by the ZekeHub team since 2024.

HOW TO USE
1. Buy a key at https://zekehub.com/pricing (Monthly £6.99 or Lifetime £18.99)
2. Paste your key between the quotes in script_key = ""
3. Run the script in any supported game

Dashboard, HWID resets and support: https://zekehub.com and https://discord.gg/zekehub

DEDICATED SCRIPTS (26 games)
Slayers 2, Blox Fruits, Rivals, Criminality, Combat Warriors, VV: Ultimatum, The Wild West, 99 Nights in the Forest, Welcome to Bloxburg, BedWars, BlockSpin, Attack on Titan Revolution, Gakuran, Volleyball Legends, Blackhawk Rescue Mission 5, Untitled Boxing Game, Phantom Forces, Racket Rivals, Death Ball, Arsenal, Illegal Soccer, Basketball Legends, Forsaken, Basketball Zero, Practical Basketball, RoBeats

FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS
- Auto farms: auto level, auto boss, auto quests, auto raids, auto fishing and more
- Combat: silent aim, aimbot, ragebot, kill aura, auto parry, hitbox expander
- Gun mods: no recoil, no spread, rapid fire, instant reload
- Movement: fly, noclip, walkspeed, infinite stamina
- ESP: boxes, names, health bars, tracers, chams
- Saved configs and a full menu with keybinds

UNIVERSAL SCRIPT (31 games)
Aimbot, silent aim, trigger bot, hitbox expander, ESP (2D and 3D boxes, chams, tracers, health), fly, noclip and walkspeed, plus extra game-specific features in:
Bad Business, Base Battles, BigPaintball 2, BloxStrike, Cold War, Combat Arena, Emergency Response: Liberty County, Energy Assault, ENTRENCHED WW1, Flag Wars, Flick, Fling Things And People, FortLine, Frontline Versus, Ground War, Gun Fight Arena, Gun Grounds FFA, Havoc, Jailbird, OneTap, OVERKILL, Operation One, Prison Life, Redliner, Sniper Arena, Sniper Duels, Strucid, TTK, Unnamed Shooter, Weaponry, Weird Gun Game

DATA NOTICE
The Luarmor key system locks your key to your device using your HWID. Keys are bought and managed on zekehub.com.
